scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @ecommbd/shared && npm run build -w @ecommbd/bd-geo
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ecommbd/admin && npm run dev -w @ecommbd/core
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ecommbd/admin && npm run build -w @ecommbd/core
scripts.store:init: npm run build:packages && npm run store:init -w @ecommbd/core --
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:packages && npm run test:e2e -w @ecommbd/core
